title: 「Especially + 例子／特別情況」句
titleEn: Using especially to highlight an example or special situation

source.file: Sentence Structure 136 -「Especially + 例子／特別情況」句.pdf
omissions: English versions of Chinese-only Important Rules and Benefits headings are faithful editorial translations.

formula: General statement + , especially + highlighted example / situation

formulas.formula: General statement + , especially + highlighted example / situation
Subject + verb + general category, especially + noun / noun phrase
Complete statement, especially + when / if + clause
Complete statement, especially + those who + clause

example: I enjoy outdoor activities, especially hiking.
exampleZh: 我喜歡戶外活動，尤其是行山。

examples.en: I enjoy outdoor activities, especially hiking.
examples.zh: 我喜歡戶外活動，尤其是行山。

examples.zh: 良好的溝通很重要，尤其是在團隊合作時。

rules.zh: 先說一般情況，再突出一個例子 Especially 前面的內容通常是一個較廣泛的類別、情況或原則；especially 後面的部分則是當中特 別值得注意的例子。 Oranges 屬於 fruit，因此兩部分的邏輯關係正確。
rules.en: State a general situation first, then highlight one example. The material before especially normally names a broad category, situation or principle, and what follows identifies a particularly notable member; oranges, for example, logically belong to the broader category fruit.

rules.zh: Especially 後面可以接不同形式 Especially 後面可以接： ● 名詞：especially science ● 名詞詞組：especially young children ● 介詞詞組：especially in winter ● 動名詞詞組：especially reading novels ● when 子句：especially when you are tired ● if 子句：especially if the road is wet ● those who 子句：especially those who live alone
rules.en: Especially can be followed by several grammatical forms: a noun, noun phrase, prepositional phrase, gerund phrase, when-clause, if-clause or those who-clause.
examples: when 子句：especially when you are tired
if 子句：especially if the road is wet
those who 子句：especially those who live alone

rules.zh: Especially 前面通常使用逗號 當 especially 放在主要陳述之後，加入補充例子或特別情況時，一般在 especially 前使用逗號。
rules.en: A comma normally comes before especially when it follows the main statement and adds an example or special situation.
examples: The road is dangerous, especially after heavy rain.

rules.zh: Especially 不一定表示「唯一」或「最」 Especially 表示「尤其、特別是」，突出某個例子，但不一定表示它是唯一的例子。 這句表示說話者特別喜歡爵士樂，但不代表他只喜歡爵士樂。
rules.en: Especially does not necessarily mean only or the most. It highlights one example without implying that it is the sole example; liking jazz especially does not mean liking only jazz.

rules.zh: Especially 和 specially 不同 Especially 表示「尤其、特別是」。 Specially 通常表示某物是「為某個特別目的而專門」製作或安排的。 本課只練習 especially。
rules.en: Especially and specially have different uses. Especially means ‘particularly’ and highlights a notable example, while specially normally means ‘for a particular purpose’ and describes something deliberately made or arranged for that purpose. This lesson practises only especially.
examples: I enjoy cold drinks, especially lemonade.
This room was specially designed for young children.

benefits.zh: 突出最值得注意的例子 這個句型讓你先表達一個整體意思，再立即指出當中需要特別注意的例子。 讀者可以立即知道哪一類人是句子的重點。
benefits.en: It highlights the most notable example by stating a general point and then identifying the example that deserves particular attention, so readers immediately see which group is the focus.
examples: Many people need support, especially elderly residents.

benefits.zh: 把兩個短句合併成一句 你不需要分開寫一個一般句和一個例子句。 使用 especially 後，句子更簡潔，兩個意思之間的關係亦更清楚。
benefits.en: It combines two short sentences in one. Instead of separating a general statement from its example, especially produces a more concise sentence and makes the relationship between the two ideas clearer.

benefits.zh: 避免重複使用 for example 當你只是想突出某一個重要例子時，可以使用 especially，而不需要每次都寫 for example。 這能增加句式變化，令說話和寫作不會過於重複。
benefits.en: It avoids repeatedly using for example when you want to highlight one important instance, adding variety to speech and writing.

benefits.zh: 清楚指出重要時間、人物或情況 Especially 不只可以介紹物件，也可以指出某個時間、群體或情況特別重要。
benefits.en: It clearly identifies an important time, person or situation; especially can introduce not only things but also times, groups and circumstances that deserve particular attention.
examples: You should be careful, especially when crossing the road.

benefits.zh: 適合日常說話和正式寫作 Especially 可以自然地用於： ● 日常對話 ● 學校作文 ● 工作電郵 ● 報告 ● 簡報 ● 意見和建議 它能幫助你由一般觀點發展到更具體的重點。
benefits.en: It suits everyday speech and formal writing, including daily conversation, school essays, workplace emails, reports, presentations, opinions and advice. It helps develop a general view into a specific focus.

sourceOmissions: English versions of Chinese-only Important Rules and Benefits headings are faithful editorial translations.

en: Rewrite each sentence or pair of sentences using especially to highlight the important example, group, time or situation.
Preserve the original meaning. Do not add or remove important information.
The first word of each answer has been provided.
zh: 使用 especially 改寫以下句子，突出其中一個重要例子、群體、時間或情況。
請保留原句意思，不要加入或刪去重要資料。
每題已提供答案的第一個字。
